value.description: The time-weighted average, so a consumer that only reads value gets a sensible number. For a binary point, the last value.

min.description: The lowest read in the window. Numeric points only.

max.description: The highest read in the window. Numeric points only.

avg.description: Time-weighted average over the time the device answered. For a binary point, the share of that time it was true, from 0 to 1.

last.description: The last value read in, or carried into, the window.

count.description: Reads in the window. 0 when the value held unchanged through it.

from.description: Start of the window (Unix ms); later than to minus the interval when partial.

to.description: End of the window (Unix ms), aligned to the clock: a multiple of the interval.

partial.description: The gateway started inside the window, so it covers only from from.

unit.description: QUDT unit identifier, e.g. unit:DEG_C, as the point's config says.

anyOf.title: Aggregate value
anyOf.description: A point's value in publish mode aggregate: one message per clock-aligned window. Published with QoS 1, not retained.

value.description: A finite number in engineering units (after scaling), or true or false for a binary point. A multi-state point publishes its state as a whole number from 1. Never NaN, Infinity or a string: a reading that is not a finite number is not published.

unit.description: QUDT unit identifier, e.g. unit:DEG_C, as the point's config says.

ts.description: When the device was read (Unix ms). Not when the message was sent: a value buffered through a broker outage arrives late with the time it was read.

anyOf.title: Value
anyOf.description: A point's value, in publish modes sample and change: one read. Published with QoS 1, not retained.

title: Value message
description: The payload on site/building/device/point. Its point's $meta says which form: publish.mode aggregate sends the aggregate form, sample and change the plain one.
